items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: We had a contest with, uh, Sun Allen. We had this contest with Sun Allen.

ctx.x: Played contest? You ever had a contest?

Yeah, yeah, we had a contest. We had a contest with, uh, Sun Allen. We had this contest with Sun Allen. Well, I tell you, how we come to have this contest, we used to rehearse them. And, uh, so some of the boys heard our band, you know, say, Man, I say, I heard a band, man. I say, I hear the band, rehearse it all the time. He said, Well, a good band. You know, tell, other fellas, tell the other fellas back, you know. Ah, man, them fellas can't play nothing. That's what the other fellas said. I say, All right. I…
And brass bands too though. Yeah, brass bands too, yeah.
